messages:
cassie: Quick escalation  nightly-recon found 19 refunds where NetSuite shows full amount refunded but Stripe only issued a partial refund. Looks like refund events got duplicated and a later partial refund replay overwrote the full refund record in NetSuite.
Tom_fin: That could leave AR under-reconciled. Dollar exposure?
cassie: Total gross mismatch $6,120. Largest single case $1,400. Stripe shows two refund events for same charge: `refund.full` (amount 1400) then `refund.updated` (amount 400) replayed later. Our handler applies latest refund state to NetSuite instead of keeping refund history.
sam: Can you paste the webhook sequence for one example? I suspect we dedupe by refund.id but treat `refund.updated` as replacement for original refund; we should treat refunds as immutable records and apply deltas as adjustments.
cassie: Example for ch_7F:

```
{ "id": "evtA", "type": "charge.refund", "payload": { "refund": { "id":"r_1","amount":140000,"status":"succeeded" } }, "created": 1700500000 }
{ "id": "evtB", "type": "charge.refund", "payload": { "refund": { "id":"r_1","amount":40000,"status":"succeeded" } }, "created": 1700500900 } // older event replayed later
```
We applied evtB after evtA because of retries; that changed the refund amount to 400 in NetSuite.
ops-bot: daily-recon job #daily-recon flagged 19 refunds mismatch. Job link: /jobs/9002
Tom_fin: Finance authorization: automated backfill ok if total < $10k. This is $6,120 so proceed but ensure strong audit trail linking to Stripe events.
sam: Short-term patch: treat refund events as append-only in NetSuite mapping. If we receive a refund with same refund.id but different amount, create an adjustment credit memo rather than replace original. I'll sketch PR: https://internal/git/refund-consumer/pull/701 - change summary: do not overwrite refund records; create delta adjustments and emit metric `refund.replay.delta_created`.
cassie: For backfill, I'll compile list of affected invoices/charges and run a script to add the missing credit memos (the delta between applied and expected). Dry-run first.

```
./scripts/refund_backfill.py --csv /secure-drive/finance/stripe_refund_mismatch_2289900001.csv --dry-run
```

billing-bot: Dry-run complete: 19 rows, total delta $6,120. Output: /tmp/refund_dryrun_2289900001.json

sam: Longer-term: add `last_event_created` per refund in Redis and reject older events that would regress refund state. But I prefer the append-only mapping to ensure accounting audibility.

ops-bot: Note: maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Avoid run during posting window.

Tom_fin: Approving backfill now. Finance requires each memo to include original and replayed event ids and justification text.

cassie: Starting backfill (rate 5/s). Will upload journal refs to secure drive when done.

billing-bot: Backfill job started job_id=90321 ETA ~12m

sam: I'll add unit tests and e2e sim for refund replay cases showing both overwrite and delta behaviors.

cassie: Backfill complete. Created 19 adjustment credit memos. Journals: /secure-drive/finance/refund_adjustments_2289900001.csv Total applied $6,120. Re-ran daily-recon: no remaining mismatches for those ids.

Tom_fin: Thanks. Filing FIN-531 for RCA: cause = replayed refund events overwrote original refund record; fix = append-only refund mapping + backfill + metrics/alert. Finance will review postmortem.

sam: Merged PR to staging; canary plan: enable append-only mode for 10% of events for 1h then full rollout. Emitting `refund.replay.delta_created` and alert if > $2k in 1h.

cassie: Closing loop. Will attach CSV and job ids to FIN-531 ticket. :thumbsup:
